summary: Iteration 70 — Verified fix for 'Member does not see Zeffy link on profile' bug. The admin URL field now auto-saves on blur with clear 'Unsaved → Saving… → Saved' badge transitions, plus the explicit 'Save URL' button is preserved with disabled-when-clean behavior. All 6 requested UX/E2E scenarios pass, all 10 iter69 regression tests pass, and the backend security boundary (PUT /members/{id} cannot mutate outstanding_zeffy_url) is intact.
verifications_performed: TEST1 (root-cause UX bug): Typed Zeffy URL into balance-zeffy-url-input → status badge 'Unsaved · auto-saves on blur' appeared. Clicked the new-line-label input to blur → saw 'Saving…' badge transition to 'Saved'. Closed dialog via Escape, reopened Edit on Maya, URL field still contained the typed URL. PASS.

TEST2 (end-to-end visibility): Added balance line {label:'10-Year Anniversary Fee', amount:150} as admin → admin balance-total shows $150.00. Logged in as maya.patel@clubhaven.app → /profile shows my-outstanding-balance card with $150.00 total, and my-balance-pay-zeffy anchor with correct href='https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/maya-test' and target='_blank'. PASS.
TEST3 (URL set, no lines): Deleted all unpaid lines but left URL set → as Maya, /profile correctly does NOT render the my-outstanding-balance section (intentional design). PASS.

TEST4 (Save URL button): Button disabled-when-clean=True, became enabled after typing a new value, click fired the save (toast text not captured by my selector at 1.8s but underlying saveZeffyUrl call succeeded; toast.success line 66 in MemberBalanceEditor.jsx is correct). PASS.

TEST5 (clear URL via blur): Cleared input, blurred via clicking line-label input → save fired silently. 'Saved' badge correctly absent (component only renders Saved badge when serverZeffyUrl is truthy by design); preview link correctly absent; downstream member /profile would not render the Pay-via-Zeffy button. PASS.

TEST6 (backend security boundary): New test /app/backend/tests/test_iteration70_zeffy_url_isolation.py — issued PUT /api/members/{maya_id} with body including outstanding_zeffy_url='https://evil.example.com/hijack' → verified GET /api/admin/members/{maya_id}/balance still returns the previously set zeffy_url unchanged. Boundary holds. PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: MemberBalanceEditor.jsx L60: saveZeffyUrl returns early when next === serverZeffyUrl (no dirty) — good no-op guard. Correctly prevents network spam on blur events when nothing changed.
MemberBalanceEditor.jsx L174-180: the 3-state badge is computed inline via an IIFE inside the Label. Works but could be a tiny derived const above the JSX for readability. Cosmetic.

MyOutstandingBalance.jsx L46-48: hiding the card when unpaid.length===0 AND pending_receipts.length===0 even if zeffy_url is set is intentional and matches the docstring. Confirmed UX-correct: a member with $0 owed doesn't need a 'Pay' button.
server.py L1077 (PUT /members/{id}): correctly ignores outstanding_zeffy_url even when injected in the payload — security boundary verified by new iter70 test.

Minor: after Save URL button click toast was not surfaced through [data-sonner-toast] selector in the 1.8s window — possibly auto-dismissed quickly. Underlying toast.success call is in place at L66; not a real defect, only a test-selector observation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin edit-button data-testid is 'edit-member-{user_id}' (not 'member-edit-{id}'). Login form has no type='email' input — both fields are plain inputs; the first is email/username, second is password. Use document.querySelectorAll('input')[0] and [1] for direct fills. The 'Saved' badge in MemberBalanceEditor is intentionally only rendered when serverZeffyUrl is truthy — after clearing the URL the badge disappears (not a bug). The member-side outstanding-balance card hides when unpaid.length===0 && pending_receipts.length===0, even if zeffy_url is set — intentional design.
rca of the issue: Original bug: admin typed Zeffy URL into the URL input then clicked the dialog's bottom 'Save changes' button, which submits PUT /api/members/{id} — an endpoint that intentionally does NOT touch outstanding_zeffy_url (security boundary, since URL changes go through a dedicated /api/admin/members/{id}/balance/zeffy-url endpoint). The URL update was silently dropped because the only way to commit it was clicking the small in-section 'Save URL' button, which admins missed. Fix (verified working in this iteration): the URL input now auto-saves on blur (silent) and on Enter, with a visible 3-state status badge ('Unsaved · auto-saves on blur' → 'Saving…' → 'Saved'). The explicit 'Save URL' button is preserved and correctly disabled-when-clean. Backend boundary remains unchanged — verified by new test_iteration70_zeffy_url_isolation.py.
